sentences.en: Hello everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: It's good to see that so many members of the public have shown up for our presentation on the new housing development planned on the outskirts of Nunston.
sentences.zh: 很高兴看到有这么多公众人士出席我们关于努斯顿郊区新住宅开发项目的介绍会。

sentences.en: I'm Mark Reynolds and I'm Communications Manager at the development.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·雷诺兹，担任该项目的传播经理。

sentences.en: I'll start by giving you a brief overview of our plans for the development.
sentences.zh: 我将首先简要概述一下我们的开发计划。

sentences.en: So one thing I'm sure you'll want to know is why we've selected this particular site for a housing development.
sentences.zh: 因此，我相信大家肯定想了解的是：我们为何选择这一特定地点来建设住宅项目。

sentences.en: At present it's being used for farming, like much of the land around Nunston.
sentences.zh: 目前，该地块正用于农业耕作，就像努斯顿周边的大部分土地一样。

sentences.en: But because of the new industrial centre in Nunston, there's a lot of demand for housing for employees in /12 the region, as many employees are having to commute long distances at present.
sentences.zh: 但由于努斯顿新建了工业中心，本地区对员工住房的需求大幅增加，目前许多员工不得不长途通勤。

sentences.en: Of course, there's also the fact that we have an international airport just 20 minutes' drive away, but although that's certainly convenient, it wasn't one of our major criteria for choosing the site.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们距离一个国际机场仅20分钟车程，虽然这的确十分便利，但它并非我们选址的主要标准之一。

sentences.en: We were more interested in the fact that there's an excellent hospital just 15 kilometres away. /12 and a large secondary school even closer than that.
sentences.zh: 我们更看重的是：距此仅15公里处就有一所设备优良的医院，而一所大型中学则离得更近。

sentences.en: One drawback to the site iS that it's on quite a steep slope, but we've taken account of that in our planning sO it shouldn't be a major problem.
sentences.zh: 该地块的一个缺点是地势相当陡峭，但我们在规划中已充分考虑了这一点，因此不应构成重大问题。

sentences.en: We've had a lot of positive feedback about the plans.
sentences.zh: 我们已收到大量积极的反馈意见。

sentences.en: People like the wide variety of accommodation types and prices, and the fact that it's only a short drive to get out into the countryside from the development.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢我们提供的多种类型与价位的住宅，也喜欢从该住宅区出发开车片刻即可抵达乡村的便利性。

sentences.en: We were particularly pleased that so many people liked Audioscripts the designs for the layout of the development, with the majority of people saying it generally made a good impression and blended in well with the natural features of the landscape, with 013/14 provision made for protecting trees and wildlife on the site.
sentences.zh: 我们尤其高兴的是，许多人赞赏了住宅区整体布局的设计方案；大多数受访者表示，该设计方案总体上给人良好印象，能很好地融入当地自然景观，并已专门规划保护现场的树木和野生动物。

sentences.en: Some people have mentioned that they'd like O see more facilities for cyclists, and we'll look at that, but the overall feedback has been that the design and facilities of the development make it seem a place where.
sentences.zh: 一些人提到希望增设更多自行车设施，我们将对此予以研究；但总体反馈认为，该开发项目的设计与配套设施使其成为一个适合……

sentences.en: /14 people of all ages can live together happily.
sentences.zh: 各年龄段人群共同幸福生活的场所。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I'lI put a map of the proposed development up on the screen.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我将在屏幕上展示拟建住宅区的地图。

sentences.en: You'll see it's bounded on the south side by the main road, which then goes on to Nunston.
sentences.zh: 您可以看到，其南侧以主干道为界，该道路继续延伸至努斯顿。

sentences.en: Another boundary is formed by London Road, on the western side of the development.
sentences.zh: 另一边界是位于住宅区西侧的伦敦路。

sentences.en: Inside the development there'll be about 400 houses and 3 apartment blocks. 3 There'll also be a school for children up to 11 years old.
sentences.zh: 住宅区内将建造约400栋住宅及3座公寓楼。此外还将建一所招收11岁以下儿童的小学。

sentences.en: If you look at the South Entrance at the bottom of the map, there's a road from there that goes right up through the development.
sentences.zh: 请看地图底部的南入口，从那里有一条道路贯穿整个住宅区。

sentences.en: The school will be on that road, at the corner of the second turning to the left.
sentences.zh: 小学就设在这条路上，位于第二个左转路口的拐角处。

sentences.en: A large sports centre is planned with is facilities for indoor and outdoor activities.
sentences.zh: 计划建设一座大型体育中心，配备室内外各类活动设施。

sentences.en: This will be on the western side of the development, just below the road that branches off from.
sentences.zh: 该中心将位于住宅区西侧，紧邻从伦敦路分岔而出的那条道路下方。

sentences.en: London Road.
sentences.zh: 伦敦路。

sentences.en: There'll be a clinic where residents can go if they have any health problems.
sentences.zh: 将设立一家诊所，供居民出现健康问题时就诊。

sentences.en: Can you see the lake towards the top of the map?
sentences.zh: 您能看到地图顶部附近的那个湖泊吗？

sentences.en: The clinic will be just below this, to the right of a street of houses.
sentences.zh: 诊所将位于该湖泊正下方，紧邻一条住宅街道的右侧。

sentences.en: There'll also be a community centre for people of all ages.
sentences.zh: 还将设立一座面向所有年龄段居民的社区中心。

sentences.en: On the northeast side of the development, there'll be a row of specially designed houses specifically for residents over 65, and the community centre will be adjoining this.
sentences.zh: 在住宅区东北侧，将建造一排专为65岁以上居民设计的住宅，社区中心将毗邻这排住宅。

sentences.en: We haven't forgotten about shopping.
sentences.zh: 我们并未忽视购物需求。

sentences.en: There'll be a supermarket between the two entrances to the development.
sentences.zh: 将在住宅区两个入口之间设立一家超市。

sentences.en: We're planning to leave the three large trees near London Road, and it'll.
sentences.zh: 我们计划保留伦敦路附近的三棵大树，超市将建于这些树的南侧。

sentences.en: be just to the south of these.
sentences.zh: 超市将位于这三棵大树的正南方。

sentences.en: It's planned to have a playground for younger children.
sentences.zh: 计划设置一处供低龄儿童使用的游乐场。

sentences.en: If you look at the road that goes up from the South Entrance, you'll see it curves round to the left at the top, and the playground will be in that curve. with nice views of the lake.
sentences.zh: 请看从南入口向上延伸的道路，您会发现它在顶端向左弯曲，游乐场就设在此弯道内，并可欣赏到湖泊的优美景色。

sentences.en: OK, so now does anyone
sentences.zh: 好的，那么现在有没有人……
